title: Leche Asada
description: Leche Asada is a dish from Chile featuring chicken egg, whole cow milk, evaporated milk. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Heat the listed ingredients over moderate heat, stirring only as needed, for about 9 minutes until amber and fragrant.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Bake the egg custard gently in a water bath at about 160°C until set with a slight wobble; refrigerate before serving.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 150 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
